summary.text: Kelly Murphy (listed by Ballotpedia as Kelly Noonan Murphy) is a Democratic state representative from Scarborough, Maine, who has represented District 125 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an educator with a J.D. from Catholic University.

paragraphs.text: Murphy lives in Scarborough, Maine, and earned a J.D. from Catholic University in 2000.
Her career experience includes working as a preschool teacher.
Murphy took office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignment for 2023-2024 as the Education and Cultural Affairs Committee and for 2025-2026 as the Bills in the Second Reading Committee.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
